### StorySettings

object: Contains the configurable settings for creating or modifying a story. Used as input in API requests.
- `index` (integer): The story index. Optional. The stories are matched to the existing ones positionally, from the bottom up. Giving the index of any of them pins the numbering of the whole list, so stories below the existing structure - basements with negative indices - can be requested as well. When given for more than one story, the indices must be consecutive.
- `dispOnSections` (boolean, required): Story level lines should appear on sections and elevations.
- `level` (number, required): The story level.
- `name` (string, required): The name of the story.

### StoriesSettings

array of StorySettings: A list of story settings, used as input for creating or modifying multiple stories.

### WallSettings

object: Settings for modifying a wall.
- `begCoordinate` (Coordinate2D)
- `endCoordinate` (Coordinate2D)

- `bottomOffset` (number): base level of the wall relative to the floor level

- `endThickness` (number): Thickness at the end in case of trapezoid wall

### ZoneSettings

object: Settings for modifying a zone. Only the given fields are changed, the polygon is kept. Set height and bottomOffset with ModifyZones: in SetDetailsOfElements they would make a wall's settings ambiguous.
- `name` (string): Name of the zone.
- `numberStr` (string): Zone number.
- `categoryAttributeId` (AttributeId): The identifier of the zone category attribute.
- `stampPosition` (Coordinate2D): Position of the origin of the zone stamp.
- `stampAngle` (number): Rotation angle of the zone stamp in radians.
- `fixedStampAngle` (boolean): If true, the zone stamp angle remains fixed when the element is rotated.
- `topOffset` (number): Offset of the top of the zone from the linked top story level. Only has an effect when relativeTopStory is non-zero.
- `relativeTopStory` (number): Non-zero links the top of the zone to another story, relative to its home story (1 is the story above), instead of an explicit height. Do not set together with height (ModifyZones) in the same call: whichever is applied last wins.
- `floorThickness` (number): Thickness of the floor finish (subfloor thickness) of the zone.
- `referencePosition` (Coordinate2D): Moves the reference point of an automatic zone; the zone is found around the new point when zones are next updated. Ignored for a manual zone (isManual true).
- `contourLine` (ZoneContourLine)
- `coverFill` (ZoneCoverFill)

object: The cover fill of a zone on the floor plan. GetDetailsOfElements returns every field; when setting, only the given fields are changed.

- `backgroundPen` (integer): The pen index of the fill background. 0 is a transparent background; -1 also occurs in projects and is accepted, so a value read with GetDetailsOfElements can always be written back.

object: Settings for modifying a Polyline. Setting coordinates replaces the entire polygon (single contour, no holes) and may change the number of vertices.

- `roomSeparator` (boolean)

### HatchSettings

object: Settings for modifying a Hatch. Setting coordinates replaces the entire polygon (outline plus optional holes) and may change the number of vertices.
- `coordinates` (array of Coordinate2D)
- `arcs` (array of PolyArc)
- `holes` (Holes2D)
- `contourPenIndex` (integer)
- `fillPenIndex` (integer): Setting a pen removes the foregroundColor override, so the pen shows.
- `fillBackgroundPenIndex` (integer): Setting a pen removes the backgroundColor override, so the pen shows.
- `foregroundColor` (ColorRGB): RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill foreground, used instead of fillPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillPenIndex when both are given.
- `backgroundColor` (ColorRGB): RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill background, used instead of fillBackgroundPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillBackgroundPenIndex when both are given.
- `fillId` (AttributeId)
- `buildingMaterialId` (AttributeId)
- `roomSpecial` (integer)
- `showArea` (boolean)

### DrawingSettings

object: Modifiable settings for a Drawing element placed on a layout.
- `pos` (Coordinate2D): Position of the drawing's reference point on the layout.
- `angle` (number): Rotation angle of the drawing in radians.
- `ratio` (number): Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view.
- `drawingScale` (number): The nominal scale of the drawing. Archicad may keep the existing value of a placed Drawing; the element's execution result is then a failure that names the value kept, although the other settings given were applied.
- `modelOffset` (Coordinate2D): Offset of the model origin within the drawing.
- `isCutWithFrame` (boolean): Whether the drawing is clipped by a custom polygon. Set to false to clear an existing crop and restore the drawing's full auto-fit extent. Only consulted when no clipPolygon is supplied in the same call - supplying a clipPolygon always enables clipping. Setting it to true without a clipPolygon merely re-enables the clip polygon already stored on the Drawing.
- `clipPolygon` (array of Coordinate2D): Polygon used to clip the drawing view, in layout coordinates (meters on the layout, the same coordinate system as pos and bounds - not the coordinates of the source view's model). It is stored as given: pos, angle, ratio and modelOffset are not applied to it, so a polygon taken from the model must be transformed to the layout first. At least 3 points. Setting this also enables polygon clipping (isCutWithFrame becomes true); to remove clipping, set isCutWithFrame to false instead.
- `nameType` (DrawingNameType)
- `customName` (string): The drawing's custom title name. Only used when nameType is CustomName.
- `numberingType` (DrawingNumberingType)
- `customNumber` (string): The drawing's custom title ID. Only used when numberingType is CustomNumber.
- `isInNumbering` (boolean): Whether the drawing is included in the automatic drawing numbering sequence.
- `isScaleIncludedInAutotextAndIndex` (boolean): The 'Include scale in Autotext and index' checkbox of Drawing Settings (API_DrawingType::includeInAutoTextsAndIES): whether the drawing's scale is included in the 'Drawing Scale' and 'Original Scale' Autotexts and in indexes. Set it to false on e.g. a 1:1 schedule drawing placed next to a 1:200 plan so that the layout's scale Autotext shows only 1:200.
- `hasBorderLine` (boolean): Whether the drawing shows a printable border (Drawing Settings > Frame > Add Printable Border).
- `borderLineTypeIndex` (integer): Attribute index of the line type of the drawing's border.
- `borderPenIndex` (integer): Pen index of the drawing's border.
- `borderSize` (number): Border size of the drawing (API_DrawingType::borderSize), in meters.
- `titleLibraryPartIndex` (number): Library part index of the drawing title (API_DrawingTitle::libInd). A negative/invalid index means no title object is instantiated; setting it to a valid index (e.g. copied from another drawing) makes Archicad create the title's own placed element.

### TextSettings

object: Settings for modifying a Text element or a text-type Label. For Labels only the text field is applied. Setting text replaces the whole content (any per-run formatting of the old content is dropped) and switches the element to automatic width, matching the behavior of CreateTexts/CreateLabels.
- `text` (string): The new text content. Newlines create multiple lines; Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are normalized to LF.
- `position` (Coordinate2D): The placement position of the text. Only applied to Text elements.
- `angle` (number): The rotation angle in radians. Only applied to Text elements.
- `height` (number): The character height in millimeters. Only applied to Text elements. A multistyle Text takes its height from the per-run sizes of its content, so applying it rebuilds the content as one paragraph with the new height on every run (the runs' own pens/fonts/faces are kept) and switches the element to automatic width, as setting text does. Refused when the content holds an autotext run; give the new content explicitly via text then, or use ModifyTexts.
- `justification` (Justification): Only applied to Text elements.

### TypeSpecificSettings

WallSettings or ZoneSettings or LineSettings or ArcSettings or HotspotSettings or SplineSettings or PolylineSettings or HatchSettings or DrawingSettings or TextSettings: Defines the modifiable type-specific settings for an element. Used as input for SET requests.

### AttributeCreationInfo

object: How, from where, by whom and when the attribute was created. Available from Archicad 30, and only for an attribute Archicad keeps a creation record of: legacy or imported attributes may have none, and then the field is left out. Any of the texts may be empty.
- `method` (string ("AddOn", "Merge", "Paste", "New", "Import", "Explode", "Duplicate", "Hotlink", "XRef", "Library", "LibraryMaster", "Unspecified"), required): The creation method or workflow: AddOn (created by an Add-On), Merge (merging files), Paste (pasting from another file), New (created by the user through the UI), Import (an attribute file, IFC, DWG/DXF or another supported format), Explode (exploding a PDF or DWG), Duplicate (duplicating an attribute), Hotlink (a hotlinked file), XRef (a file attached in the Xref manager), Library (a library part), LibraryMaster (generated from GDL) or Unspecified.
- `methodDescription` (string, required): Human-readable description of the creation method.
- `source` (string, required): Human-readable origin, for example the name of the file or Add-On the attribute came from.
- `creatorUserName` (string, required): The Teamwork user name, or the OS login name in a solo project, at the time of creation.
- `creationTime` (integer, required): The creation time of the attribute, in seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC (a GSTime), the same scale as modificationTime.

### TextRunDetails

object: One monostyle run of text (API_RunType). Concatenating 'text' across all runs in order gives the full content; a newline character starts a new line.
- `text` (string, required): The run's text content. Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are normalized to LF.
- `penIndex` (integer): Pen attribute index. Optional; defaults to the style's penIndex.
- `fontIndex` (integer): Font attribute index. Optional; defaults to the style's fontIndex.
- `fontName` (string): Name of the font for this run only, resolved like the style's fontName (and taking precedence over the run's fontIndex). Optional; defaults to the style's font. Read back as the name of the font the run's fontIndex refers to, absent when no loaded font has that index.
- `bold` (boolean)
- `italic` (boolean)
- `underline` (boolean)
- `heightOverride` (number): Character height in mm for this run only. Optional; defaults to the style's height.
- `effectStrikeout` (boolean): Optional; defaults to the style's effectStrikeout.
- `effectSuperscript` (boolean): Optional; defaults to the style's effectSuperscript.
- `effectSubscript` (boolean): Optional; defaults to the style's effectSubscript.
- `effectProtected` (boolean): Optional; defaults to the style's effectProtected.

### TextStyleSettableDetails

object: Every user-configurable style setting of a Text or a text-class Label (API_TextType). Shared by CreateTexts/CreateLabels ('style'), ModifyTexts/ModifyLabels ('style'), and the Get response.
- `penIndex` (integer): Pen attribute index.
- `fontIndex` (integer): Font attribute index.
- `fontName` (string): Name of the font, as the Font attributes carry it and GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName, e.g. 'Arial'. Resolved to the font's index (exact match first, then case-insensitive); the command fails when no loaded font has the name. Takes precedence over fontIndex if both are given.
- `bold` (boolean)
- `italic` (boolean)
- `underline` (boolean)
- `justification` (Justification)
- `height` (number): Character height in mm.
- `spacing` (number): Line spacing factor, between -10.0 and -1.0.
- `angle` (number): Rotation angle in radians.
- `effectStrikeout` (boolean)
- `effectSuperscript` (boolean)
- `effectSubscript` (boolean)
- `effectProtected` (boolean): Protected text (autotext reference).
- `widthFactor` (number): Width scale of the text, between 0.75 and 10.0.
- `charSpaceFactor` (number): Character spacing scale, between 0.75 and 10.0.
- `fixedSize` (boolean): Size does not depend on output scale.
- `usedContour` (boolean): Draw the frame of the text block.
- `usedFill` (boolean): Draw a solid fill behind the text block.
- `contourPenIndex` (integer): Pen index of the text block's frame.
- `fillPenIndex` (integer): Pen index of the text block's background fill.
- `anchor` (TextBoxAnchor)
- `fixedAngle` (boolean): The rotation angle does not change when the element is rotated.
- `contourOffset` (number): Offset of the frame/background fill from the text bounding box, in mm.
- `flipEnabled` (boolean): The text should always be readable (flips when viewed upside down).
- `textFrameShape` (string ("Rectangle", "Circle", "RoundedRectangle", "Pill")): Text frame shape. Standalone Text elements only support Rectangle. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as Rectangle.
- `textFrameSizeFixed` (boolean): Use fixedWidth/fixedHeight instead of fitting the frame to the text box. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as false.
- `textFrameFixedWidth` (number): Frame width in mm, when textFrameSizeFixed is true. Between 1 and 1000. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as 0.
- `textFrameFixedHeight` (number): Frame height in mm, when textFrameSizeFixed is true (ignored for Circle, which uses fixedWidth as diameter). Between 1 and 1000. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as 0.

### TextStyleDetails

object: Full readable style state of a Text or text-class Label: every field of TextStyleSettableDetails plus the read-only ones (lineCount, boxWidth, boxHeight).
- `penIndex` (integer): Pen attribute index.
- `fontIndex` (integer): Font attribute index.
- `fontName` (string): The name of the font fontIndex refers to, as the Font attributes carry it. Absent when no loaded font has that index.
- `bold` (boolean)
- `italic` (boolean)
- `underline` (boolean)
- `justification` (Justification)
- `height` (number): Character height in mm.
- `spacing` (number): Line spacing factor, between -10.0 and -1.0.
- `angle` (number): Rotation angle in radians.
- `effectStrikeout` (boolean)
- `effectSuperscript` (boolean)
- `effectSubscript` (boolean)
- `effectProtected` (boolean): Protected text (autotext reference).
- `widthFactor` (number): Width scale of the text, between 0.75 and 10.0.
- `charSpaceFactor` (number): Character spacing scale, between 0.75 and 10.0.
- `fixedSize` (boolean): Size does not depend on output scale.
- `usedContour` (boolean): Draw the frame of the text block.
- `usedFill` (boolean): Draw a solid fill behind the text block.
- `contourPenIndex` (integer): Pen index of the text block's frame.
- `fillPenIndex` (integer): Pen index of the text block's background fill.
- `anchor` (TextBoxAnchor)
- `fixedAngle` (boolean): The rotation angle does not change when the element is rotated.
- `contourOffset` (number): Offset of the frame/background fill from the text bounding box, in mm.
- `flipEnabled` (boolean): The text should always be readable (flips when viewed upside down).
- `textFrameShape` (string ("Rectangle", "Circle", "RoundedRectangle", "Pill")): Text frame shape. Standalone Text elements only support Rectangle. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as Rectangle.
- `textFrameSizeFixed` (boolean): Use fixedWidth/fixedHeight instead of fitting the frame to the text box. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as false.
- `textFrameFixedWidth` (number): Frame width in mm, when textFrameSizeFixed is true. Between 1 and 1000. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as 0.
- `textFrameFixedHeight` (number): Frame height in mm, when textFrameSizeFixed is true (ignored for Circle, which uses fixedWidth as diameter). Between 1 and 1000. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as 0.
- `lineCount` (integer): Read-only: number of text lines (API_TextType::nLine).
- `boxWidth` (number): Read-only: horizontal size of the text box in mm, auto-computed by Archicad.
- `boxHeight` (number): Read-only: vertical size of the text box in mm, auto-computed by Archicad.

### WallQuantities

object: Quantities of a Wall element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.
- `volume` (number, required): Net volume of the wall.
- `volumeConditional` (number, required): Conditional net volume of the wall (openings smaller than minOpeningSize are not subtracted).
- `grossVolume` (number, required): Gross volume of the wall (openings not subtracted).
- `referenceSideSurface` (number, required): Net surface on the reference line side.
- `oppositeSideSurface` (number, required): Net surface on the side opposite to the reference line.
- `edgeSurface` (number, required): Surface of the edges of the wall.
- `referenceSideSurfaceConditional` (number, required): Conditional surface on the reference line side.
- `oppositeSideSurfaceConditional` (number, required): Conditional surface on the side opposite to the reference line.
- `grossReferenceSideSurface` (number, required): Gross surface on the reference line side.
- `grossOppositeSideSurface` (number, required): Gross surface on the side opposite to the reference line.
- `length` (number, required): Average of the lengths on the two sides of the wall.
- `referenceSideLength` (number, required): Length on the reference line side.
- `oppositeSideLength` (number, required): Length on the side opposite to the reference line.
- `centerLength` (number, required): Length of the wall at its center.
- `referenceLineLength` (number, required): Length of the reference line.
- `minHeight` (number, required): Minimum height of the wall.
- `maxHeight` (number, required): Maximum height of the wall.
- `area` (number, required): Floor plan area of the wall.
- `perimeter` (number, required): Floor plan perimeter of the wall.
- `windowsSurface` (number, required): Surface of the windows in the wall.
- `doorsSurface` (number, required): Surface of the doors in the wall.
- `emptyOpeningsSurface` (number, required): Surface of the empty openings in the wall.
- `emptyOpeningsVolume` (number, required): Volume of the empty openings in the wall.

### ColumnQuantities

object: Quantities of a Column element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.
- `coreVolume` (number, required): Net volume of the column core.
- `veneerVolume` (number, required): Net volume of the column veneer.
- `coreGrossVolume` (number, required): Gross volume of the column core.
- `veneerGrossVolume` (number, required): Gross volume of the column veneer.
- `coreSurface` (number, required): Net side surface of the column core.
- `veneerSurface` (number, required): Net side surface of the column veneer.
- `coreGrossSurface` (number, required): Gross side surface of the column core.
- `veneerGrossSurface` (number, required): Gross side surface of the column veneer.
- `area` (number, required): Floor plan area of the column.
- `perimeter` (number, required): Floor plan perimeter of the column.
- `minHeight` (number, required): Minimum height of the column.
- `maxHeight` (number, required): Maximum height of the column.
- `crossSectionAreaCutBegin` (number, required): Area of the cross section at the beginning of the column.
- `crossSectionAreaCutEnd` (number, required): Area of the cross section at the end of the column.

### BeamQuantities

object: Quantities of a Beam element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.
- `volume` (number, required): Net volume of the beam.
- `volumeConditional` (number, required): Conditional net volume of the beam.

### GraphicOverrideElementType

string ("Wall", "Column", "Beam", "Slab", "Roof", "Shell", "Stair", "Railing", "CurtainWall", "Opening", "Mesh", "Morph", ...): The tool an element was created with. Limited to tools that are not backed by a built-in GDL library part (Door, Window, Object, Lamp, Zone, Label, Grid and most MEP part types are intentionally excluded - their identification relies on a library part guid that was confirmed to differ across ArchiCAD builds, so it cannot be hardcoded reliably).

### GraphicOverrideCriterion

object: Structured conditions of a graphic override rule, turned into Archicad's criterion XML (an alternative to criterionXML). Give exactly one property. 'and'/'or' combine a flat list of other conditions (no nesting, see their description). 'elementType' filters by the tool an element was created with; 'all3DTypes'/'all2DTypes' match every 3D or 2D element. The other properties are conditions of Archicad's criteria editor: classification, layer and Model View, Construction, Positioning, Plan and Section, Surfaces and Materials, ID and Categories, Geometry, custom properties, and fields of the Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Object/Lamp, Door/Window, Opening, Curtain Wall and Stair tools. Their identifiers were captured from rules made in the criteria editor of Archicad 29; Archicad 27 keeps the generated rules as well. Not available: the renovation status of an element, and the shape, limits and orientation of an Opening.
- `and` (array of GraphicOverrideCriterion): Matches if all of the nested criteria match. The nested criteria must all be leaves (elementType, classification, layer*, ...) - an 'and'/'or' nested inside this array is rejected, ArchiCAD's criteria editor does not reliably support that depth of nesting.
- `or` (array of GraphicOverrideCriterion): Matches if any of the nested criteria match. The nested criteria must all be leaves (elementType, classification, layer*, ...) - an 'and'/'or' nested inside this array is rejected, ArchiCAD's criteria editor does not reliably support that depth of nesting.
- `elementType` (GraphicOverrideElementType): Matches elements created with this tool.
- `classification` (string): Matches elements classified with this Classification System item ID (e.g. 'Slab'), or with any descendant of it in the classification tree (ArchiCAD's 'is in the branch of' operator - not a strict equality check).
- `classificationNot` (string): Matches elements NOT classified with this Classification System item ID and not with any descendant of it in the classification tree (ArchiCAD's 'is not in the branch of' operator - not a strict inequality check).
- `classificationSystem` (string): The classification system 'classification'/'classificationNot' refers to: its name as shown in the Classification Manager (e.g. 'Classification Archicad'), or its name and version as the criteria editor shows them (e.g. 'Classification Archicad - v 2.0'). Left out: the only classification system of the project that contains the item ID; an error when several do.
- `all3DTypes` (boolean): If true, matches every 3D model element type.
- `all2DTypes` (boolean): If true, matches every 2D drawing element type.
- `missingAttributes` (boolean): Matches elements whose 'Missing attributes' status equals this value.
- `missingLibraryPart` (boolean): Matches elements whose 'Missing library part' status equals this value (e.g. an Object/Lamp referencing a library part not found in the loaded libraries).
- `layer` (string): Matches elements on this layer (by layer name).
- `layerNot` (string): Matches elements NOT on this layer (by layer name).
- `layerLocked` (boolean): Matches elements whose layer's locked state equals this value.
- `layerVisible` (boolean): Matches elements whose layer's visible state equals this value.
- `layerCombination` (string): Matches elements whose layer is shown in this layer combination (by layer combination name). ArchiCAD only offers 'contains'/'does not contain' for this field, no strict equality.
- `layerCombinationNot` (string): Matches elements whose layer is NOT shown in this layer combination (by layer combination name).
- `layerNameIs` (string): Matches elements whose layer name equals this string exactly.
- `layerNameIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose layer name does not equal this string.
- `layerNameContains` (string): Matches elements whose layer name contains this substring.
- `layerNameNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose layer name does not contain this substring.
- `layerNameStartsWith` (string): Matches elements whose layer name starts with this substring.
- `layerNameEndsWith` (string): Matches elements whose layer name ends with this substring.
- `compositeStructure` (string): Matches elements built with this Composite Structure attribute (by name).
- `compositeStructureNot` (string): Matches elements NOT built with this Composite Structure attribute (by name).
- `complexProfile` (string): Matches elements built with this Complex Profile attribute (by name).
- `complexProfileNot` (string): Matches elements NOT built with this Complex Profile attribute (by name).
- `compositeStructureNameIs` (string): Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name equals this string exactly.
- `compositeStructureNameIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name does not equal this string.
- `compositeStructureNameContains` (string): Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name contains this substring.
- `compositeStructureNameNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name does not contain this substring.
- `compositeStructureNameStartsWith` (string): Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name starts with this substring.
- `compositeStructureNameEndsWith` (string): Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name ends with this substring.
- `complexProfileNameIs` (string): Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name equals this string exactly.
- `complexProfileNameIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name does not equal this string.
- `complexProfileNameContains` (string): Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name contains this substring.
- `complexProfileNameNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name does not contain this substring.
- `complexProfileNameStartsWith` (string): Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name starts with this substring.
- `complexProfileNameEndsWith` (string): Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name ends with this substring.
- `roofConnected` (boolean): Matches roofs whose 'connected to other roof(s)' status equals this value.
- `structureType` (string ("Basic", "Composite", "ComplexProfile")): Matches elements whose structure type (Wall/Beam/Column basic vs. composite vs. complex profile) equals this value.
- `seaLevelAltitude` (number): Matches elements whose sea level altitude equals this value.
- `seaLevelAltitudeNot` (number): Matches elements whose sea level altitude does not equal this value.
- `seaLevelAltitudeLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose sea level altitude is less than this value.
- `seaLevelAltitudeGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose sea level altitude is greater than this value.
- `seaLevelAltitudeLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose sea level altitude is less than or equal to this value.
- `seaLevelAltitudeGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose sea level altitude is greater than or equal to this value.
- `projectZeroAltitude` (number): Matches elements whose altitude to project zero equals this value.
- `projectZeroAltitudeNot` (number): Matches elements whose altitude to project zero does not equal this value.
- `projectZeroAltitudeLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose altitude to project zero is less than this value.
- `projectZeroAltitudeGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose altitude to project zero is greater than this value.
- `projectZeroAltitudeLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose altitude to project zero is less than or equal to this value.
- `projectZeroAltitudeGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose altitude to project zero is greater than or equal to this value.
- `groundFloorAltitude` (number): Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor equals this value.
- `groundFloorAltitudeNot` (number): Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor does not equal this value.
- `groundFloorAltitudeLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor is less than this value.
- `groundFloorAltitudeGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor is greater than this value.
- `groundFloorAltitudeLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor is less than or equal to this value.
- `groundFloorAltitudeGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor is greater than or equal to this value.
- `roofAltitude` (number): Matches elements whose roof altitude equals this value.
- `roofAltitudeNot` (number): Matches elements whose roof altitude does not equal this value.
- `roofAltitudeLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose roof altitude is less than this value.
- `roofAltitudeGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose roof altitude is greater than this value.
- `roofAltitudeLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose roof altitude is less than or equal to this value.
- `roofAltitudeGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose roof altitude is greater than or equal to this value.
- `floorIndex` (integer): Matches elements whose placement story equals this 0-based story/floor index (same convention as floorIndex elsewhere in Tapir). Only equality is supported - ArchiCAD's criteria editor does not offer a 'not equal' option for this field.
- `sillHeight` (number): Matches Door/Window/RoofWindow/Opening elements whose sill height equals this value.
- `sillHeightNot` (number)
- `sillHeightLessThan` (number)
- `sillHeightGreaterThan` (number)
- `sillHeightLessOrEqual` (number)
- `sillHeightGreaterOrEqual` (number)
- `lintelHeight` (number): Matches Door/Window/RoofWindow/Opening elements whose lintel height equals this value.
- `lintelHeightNot` (number)
- `lintelHeightLessThan` (number)
- `lintelHeightGreaterThan` (number)
- `lintelHeightLessOrEqual` (number)
- `lintelHeightGreaterOrEqual` (number)
- `screedThickness` (number): Matches Door/Window/RoofWindow elements whose screed thickness ('Epaisseur chape') equals this value.
- `screedThicknessNot` (number)
- `screedThicknessLessThan` (number)
- `screedThicknessGreaterThan` (number)
- `screedThicknessLessOrEqual` (number)
- `screedThicknessGreaterOrEqual` (number)
- `linkedUpperStoryAbsolute` (integer): Matches Stair/Zone elements whose absolute linked upper story equals this 0-based story index. Only equality is supported. -31001 means 'not linked' ('Non lie').
- `linkedUpperStoryRelative` (integer): Matches Stair/Zone elements whose relative linked upper story equals this value. Only equality is supported. -31001 means 'not linked' ('Non lie').
- `mepDiameter` (number): Matches MEP elements whose diameter equals this value.
- `mepDiameterNot` (number)
- `mepDiameterLessThan` (number)
- `mepDiameterGreaterThan` (number)
- `mepDiameterLessOrEqual` (number)
- `mepDiameterGreaterOrEqual` (number)
- `mepDiameter2` (number): Matches MEP elements whose 2nd diameter equals this value.
- `mepDiameter2Not` (number)
- `mepDiameter2LessThan` (number)
- `mepDiameter2GreaterThan` (number)
- `mepDiameter2LessOrEqual` (number)
- `mepDiameter2GreaterOrEqual` (number)
- `mepDN` (integer): Matches MEP elements whose nominal diameter (DN) equals this value.
- `mepDNNot` (integer)
- `mepDNLessThan` (integer)
- `mepDNGreaterThan` (integer)

- `fontIs` (string): Matches elements whose font equals this font name (as GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName, with its script, e.g. 'Arial Western') exactly. Applies to 2D annotation (Text/Label) elements - unlike every other field in this schema, this one and 'textPen*' are NOT combined with a 3D-model-element anchor when used alone or together, since they don't apply to 3D model elements.
- `fontContains` (string): Matches elements whose font is one of a list containing this font name (as GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName, with its script, e.g. 'Arial Western') (ArchiCAD's 'contains' operator for a font field).
- `fontNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose font is not one of a list containing this font name (as GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName, with its script, e.g. 'Arial Western').
- `penReplacement` (string ("None", "ForegroundOnly", "BackgroundOnly", "Both")): Matches elements whose pen replacement rule equals this value.
- `penReplacementNot` (string ("None", "ForegroundOnly", "BackgroundOnly", "Both")): Matches elements whose pen replacement rule does not equal this value.
- `linePenContains` (integer): Matches elements whose line pen number is this value (by plain pen number 1-255, not an attribute name). ArchiCAD only offers 'contains'/'does not contain' for this field, no strict equality.
- `linePenNotContains` (integer): Matches elements whose line pen number is NOT this value (by plain pen number 1-255).
- `textPenIs` (integer): Matches elements whose text pen number equals this value (by plain pen number 1-255). Applies to 2D annotation elements - see 'fontIs' for the anchor-exemption note.
- `textPenContains` (integer): Matches elements whose text pen number is this value (ArchiCAD's 'contains' operator for a pen field, by plain pen number 1-255).
- `textPenNotContains` (integer): Matches elements whose text pen number is NOT this value (by plain pen number 1-255).
- `hatchContourPen` (integer): Matches elements whose hatch contour pen number equals this value (by plain pen number 1-255). Unlike 'linePenContains', ArchiCAD offers strict is/is-not here, not contains/does-not-contain.
- `hatchContourPenNot` (integer): Matches elements whose hatch contour pen number does not equal this value (by plain pen number 1-255).
- `openingEndSurface` (string): Matches Opening elements whose end surface equals this Surface attribute (by name).
- `openingEndSurfaceNot` (string): Matches Opening elements whose end surface does not equal this Surface attribute (by name).
- `openingExtrusionSurface` (string): Matches Opening elements whose extrusion surface equals this Surface attribute (by name).
- `openingExtrusionSurfaceNot` (string): Matches Opening elements whose extrusion surface does not equal this Surface attribute (by name).
- `curtainWallFrameCutLine` (string): Matches Curtain Wall elements whose frame cut line equals this Line Type attribute (by name).
- `curtainWallFrameCutLineNot` (string): Matches Curtain Wall elements whose frame cut line does not equal this Line Type attribute (by name).
- `curtainWallPanelCutLine` (string): Matches Curtain Wall elements whose panel cut line equals this Line Type attribute (by name).
- `curtainWallPanelCutLineNot` (string): Matches Curtain Wall elements whose panel cut line does not equal this Line Type attribute (by name).
- `curtainWallFrameCutLinePen` (integer): Matches Curtain Wall elements whose frame cut line pen number equals this value (by plain pen number 1-255).
- `curtainWallFrameCutLinePenNot` (integer): Matches Curtain Wall elements whose frame cut line pen number does not equal this value.
- `curtainWallPanelCutLinePen` (integer): Matches Curtain Wall elements whose panel cut line pen number equals this value (by plain pen number 1-255).
- `curtainWallPanelCutLinePenNot` (integer): Matches Curtain Wall elements whose panel cut line pen number does not equal this value.
- `constructionMaterial` (string): Matches elements built with this Building Material attribute (by name). ArchiCAD only offers 'contains'/'does not contain' for this field, no strict equality.
- `constructionMaterialNot` (string): Matches elements NOT built with this Building Material attribute (by name).
- `surface` (string): Matches elements whose surface is this Surface (Material) attribute (by name). ArchiCAD only offers 'contains'/'does not contain' for this field, no strict equality.
- `surfaceNot` (string): Matches elements whose surface is NOT this Surface (Material) attribute (by name).
- `constructionMaterialIdIs` (string): Matches elements whose construction material ID equals this string exactly.
- `constructionMaterialIdIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose construction material ID does not equal this string.
- `constructionMaterialIdContains` (string): Matches elements whose construction material ID contains this substring.
- `constructionMaterialIdNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose construction material ID does not contain this substring.
- `constructionMaterialIdStartsWith` (string): Matches elements whose construction material ID starts with this substring.
- `constructionMaterialIdEndsWith` (string): Matches elements whose construction material ID ends with this substring.
- `constructionMaterialNameIs` (string): Matches elements whose Building Material attribute name equals this string exactly.
- `constructionMaterialNameIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose Building Material attribute name does not equal this string.
- `constructionMaterialNameContains` (string): Matches elements whose Building Material attribute name contains this substring.
- `constructionMaterialNameNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose Building Material attribute name does not contain this substring.
- `constructionMaterialNameStartsWith` (string): Matches elements whose Building Material attribute name starts with this substring.
- `constructionMaterialNameEndsWith` (string): Matches elements whose Building Material attribute name ends with this substring.
- `surfaceNameIs` (string): Matches elements whose Surface (Material) attribute name equals this string exactly.
- `surfaceNameIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose Surface (Material) attribute name does not equal this string.
- `surfaceNameContains` (string): Matches elements whose Surface (Material) attribute name contains this substring.
- `surfaceNameNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose Surface (Material) attribute name does not contain this substring.
- `surfaceNameStartsWith` (string): Matches elements whose Surface (Material) attribute name starts with this substring.
- `surfaceNameEndsWith` (string): Matches elements whose Surface (Material) attribute name ends with this substring.
- `renovationFilterIs` (string): Matches elements whose Renovation Filter display status equals this filter name exactly.
- `renovationFilterIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose Renovation Filter display status does not equal this filter name.
- `structuralFunction` (string ("LoadBearing", "NonLoadBearing", "Undefined")): Matches elements whose structural function equals this value.
- `structuralFunctionNot` (string ("LoadBearing", "NonLoadBearing", "Undefined")): Matches elements whose structural function does not equal this value.
- `position` (string ("Exterior", "Interior", "Undefined")): Matches elements whose position equals this value.
- `positionNot` (string ("Exterior", "Interior", "Undefined")): Matches elements whose position does not equal this value.
- `variantStateIs` (string): Matches elements whose Variant State equals this string exactly (e.g. 'Main Model'). Variants are an Archicad 27+ feature - this criterion is meaningless on earlier versions.
- `variantStateIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose Variant State does not equal this string. Variants are an Archicad 27+ feature - this criterion is meaningless on earlier versions.
- `variantSetIs` (string): Matches elements whose Variant Set equals this string exactly (e.g. 'Main Model'). Variants are an Archicad 27+ feature - this criterion is meaningless on earlier versions.
- `variantSetIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose Variant Set does not equal this string. Variants are an Archicad 27+ feature - this criterion is meaningless on earlier versions.
- `elementIdIs` (string): Matches elements whose element ID equals this string exactly.
- `elementIdIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose element ID does not equal this string.
- `elementIdLessThan` (string): Matches elements whose element ID is less than this string (lexicographic comparison, stored as text).
- `elementIdGreaterThan` (string): Matches elements whose element ID is greater than this string.
- `elementIdLessOrEqual` (string): Matches elements whose element ID is less than or equal to this string.
- `elementIdGreaterOrEqual` (string): Matches elements whose element ID is greater than or equal to this string.
- `elementIdContains` (string): Matches elements whose element ID contains this substring.
- `elementIdNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose element ID does not contain this substring.
- `elementIdStartsWith` (string): Matches elements whose element ID starts with this substring.
- `elementIdEndsWith` (string): Matches elements whose element ID ends with this substring.
- `uniqueIdIs` (string): Matches elements whose unique ID equals this string exactly.
- `uniqueIdIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose unique ID does not equal this string.
- `uniqueIdContains` (string): Matches elements whose unique ID contains this substring.
- `uniqueIdNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose unique ID does not contain this substring.
- `uniqueIdStartsWith` (string): Matches elements whose unique ID starts with this substring.
- `uniqueIdEndsWith` (string): Matches elements whose unique ID ends with this substring.
- `linkMainIdIs` (string): Matches elements whose link's main identifier equals this string exactly.
- `linkMainIdIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose link's main identifier does not equal this string.
- `linkMainIdLessThan` (string): Matches elements whose link's main identifier is less than this string.
- `linkMainIdGreaterThan` (string): Matches elements whose link's main identifier is greater than this string.
- `linkMainIdLessOrEqual` (string): Matches elements whose link's main identifier is less than or equal to this string.
- `linkMainIdGreaterOrEqual` (string): Matches elements whose link's main identifier is greater than or equal to this string.
- `linkMainIdContains` (string): Matches elements whose link's main identifier contains this substring.
- `linkMainIdNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose link's main identifier does not contain this substring.
- `linkMainIdStartsWith` (string): Matches elements whose link's main identifier starts with this substring.
- `linkMainIdEndsWith` (string): Matches elements whose link's main identifier ends with this substring.
- `linkedElementIdIs` (string): Matches elements whose 'linked element ID' equals this string exactly.
- `linkedElementIdIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose 'linked element ID' does not equal this string.
- `linkedElementIdLessThan` (string): Matches elements whose 'linked element ID' is less than this string.
- `linkedElementIdGreaterThan` (string): Matches elements whose 'linked element ID' is greater than this string.
- `linkedElementIdLessOrEqual` (string): Matches elements whose 'linked element ID' is less than or equal to this string.
- `linkedElementIdGreaterOrEqual` (string): Matches elements whose 'linked element ID' is greater than or equal to this string.
- `linkedElementIdContains` (string): Matches elements whose 'linked element ID' contains this substring.
- `linkedElementIdNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose 'linked element ID' does not contain this substring.
- `linkedElementIdStartsWith` (string): Matches elements whose 'linked element ID' starts with this substring.
- `linkedElementIdEndsWith` (string): Matches elements whose 'linked element ID' ends with this substring.
- `nameIs` (string): Matches elements whose name equals this string exactly.
- `nameIsNot` (string): Matches elements whose name does not equal this string.
- `nameContains` (string): Matches elements whose name contains this substring.
- `nameNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose name does not contain this substring.
- `nameStartsWith` (string): Matches elements whose name starts with this substring.
- `nameEndsWith` (string): Matches elements whose name ends with this substring.
- `hasLinkSource` (boolean): If true, matches elements linked to any link source.
- `hasLinkSourceNot` (boolean): If true, matches elements NOT linked to any link source.
- `missingVariant` (boolean): Matches elements whose 'missing variant' status equals this value.
- `profileStretchHeight` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'height stretch' modifier equals this value.
- `profileStretchHeightNot` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'height stretch' modifier does not equal this value.
- `profileStretchHeightLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'height stretch' modifier is less than this value.
- `profileStretchHeightGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'height stretch' modifier is greater than this value.
- `profileStretchHeightLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'height stretch' modifier is less than or equal to this value.
- `profileStretchHeightGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'height stretch' modifier is greater than or equal to this value.
- `profileStretchWidth` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'width stretch' modifier equals this value.
- `profileStretchWidthNot` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'width stretch' modifier does not equal this value.
- `profileStretchWidthLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'width stretch' modifier is less than this value.
- `profileStretchWidthGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'width stretch' modifier is greater than this value.
- `profileStretchWidthLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'width stretch' modifier is less than or equal to this value.
- `profileStretchWidthGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'width stretch' modifier is greater than or equal to this value.
- `profileNominalHeight` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal height equals this value.
- `profileNominalHeightNot` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal height does not equal this value.
- `profileNominalHeightLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal height is less than this value.
- `profileNominalHeightGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal height is greater than this value.
- `profileNominalHeightLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal height is less than or equal to this value.
- `profileNominalHeightGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal height is greater than or equal to this value.
- `profileTotalHeight` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total height equals this value.
- `profileTotalHeightNot` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total height does not equal this value.
- `profileTotalHeightLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total height is less than this value.
- `profileTotalHeightGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total height is greater than this value.
- `profileTotalHeightLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total height is less than or equal to this value.
- `profileTotalHeightGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total height is greater than or equal to this value.
- `profileTotalWidth` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total width equals this value.
- `profileTotalWidthNot` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total width does not equal this value.
- `profileTotalWidthLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total width is less than this value.
- `profileTotalWidthGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total width is greater than this value.
- `profileTotalWidthLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total width is less than or equal to this value.
- `profileTotalWidthGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total width is greater than or equal to this value.
- `profileNominalWidth` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal width equals this value.
- `profileNominalWidthNot` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal width does not equal this value.
- `profileNominalWidthLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal width is less than this value.
- `profileNominalWidthGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal width is greater than this value.
- `profileNominalWidthLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal width is less than or equal to this value.
- `profileNominalWidthGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal width is greater than or equal to this value.
- `profileParameter` (object): Matches elements by a custom Complex Profile modifier parameter, identified by its plain name as defined on that Complex Profile attribute (e.g. 'Debord tole') rather than a fixed field - use this for any profile modifier not covered by the profileStretchHeight/profileNominalWidth/... fields above. Provide 'name' and exactly one comparison operator.
  - `name` (string, required): The profile modifier parameter's name, exactly as defined on the Complex Profile attribute.
  - `equals` (number)
  - `notEquals` (number)
  - `lessThan` (number)
  - `greaterThan` (number)
  - `lessOrEqual` (number)
  - `greaterOrEqual` (number)
- `customPropertyBool` (object): Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) boolean property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under (both exactly as shown in the Property Manager). Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one of the operators below. The 6 'has.../is...' operators are available on every custom property type, not just boolean ones.
  - `name` (string, required): The custom property's name, exactly as defined.
  - `group` (string, required): The custom property group's name, exactly as defined (e.g. 'Generalites').
  - `equals` (boolean): Matches if the property's value equals this.
  - `hasDefaultValue` (boolean): If true, matches elements where this property currently has its default value.
  - `hasCustomValue` (boolean): If true, matches elements where this property has a custom (overridden, non-default) value.
  - `isAvailable` (boolean): If true, matches elements where this property is available.
  - `isNotAvailable` (boolean): If true, matches elements where this property is not available.
  - `isUndefined` (boolean): If true, matches elements where this property is undefined.
  - `isNotUndefined` (boolean): If true, matches elements where this property is not undefined.
- `customPropertyString` (object): Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) text or option-set property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator.
  - `name` (string, required): The custom property's name, exactly as defined.
  - `group` (string, required): The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.
  - `equals` (string): Matches if the property's value equals this string exactly.
  - `notEquals` (string): Matches if the property's value does not equal this string.
  - `hasDefaultValue` (boolean)
  - `hasCustomValue` (boolean)
  - `isAvailable` (boolean)
  - `isNotAvailable` (boolean)
  - `isUndefined` (boolean)
  - `isNotUndefined` (boolean)
- `customPropertyNumber` (object): Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) numeric property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator.
  - `name` (string, required): The custom property's name, exactly as defined.
  - `group` (string, required): The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.
  - `equals` (number)
  - `notEquals` (number)
  - `lessThan` (number)
  - `greaterThan` (number)
  - `lessOrEqual` (number)
  - `greaterOrEqual` (number)
  - `hasDefaultValue` (boolean)
  - `hasCustomValue` (boolean)
  - `isAvailable` (boolean)
  - `isNotAvailable` (boolean)
  - `isUndefined` (boolean)
  - `isNotUndefined` (boolean)
- `customPropertyInteger` (object): Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) integer property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator.
  - `name` (string, required): The custom property's name, exactly as defined.
  - `group` (string, required): The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.
  - `equals` (integer)
  - `notEquals` (integer)
  - `lessThan` (integer)
  - `greaterThan` (integer)
  - `lessOrEqual` (integer)
  - `greaterOrEqual` (integer)
  - `hasDefaultValue` (boolean)
  - `hasCustomValue` (boolean)
  - `isAvailable` (boolean)
  - `isNotAvailable` (boolean)
  - `isUndefined` (boolean)
  - `isNotUndefined` (boolean)

### GraphicOverrideCombinationIdOrError

GraphicOverrideCombinationIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: A graphic override combination identifier or an error.

### GraphicOverrideFillTypes

object: The fill types an override applies to.
- `cutFill` (boolean, required): Applies to cut fills.
- `coverFill` (boolean, required): Applies to cover fills.
- `draftingFill` (boolean, required): Applies to drafting fills.

### GraphicOverrideSurfaceTypes

object: The surface types an override applies to.
- `cutSurface` (boolean, required): Applies to cut surfaces.
- `uncutSurface` (boolean, required): Applies to uncut surfaces.

### GraphicOverrideStyle

object: What a graphic override rule overrides and how. A field that is left out is not overridden.
- `lineType` (AttributeId): The line type that replaces the line type of lines.
- `lineMarkerTextPen` (integer): The pen index that replaces the pen of lines, markers and texts.
- `fillType` (AttributeId): The fill type that replaces the fill type of fills.
- `fillTypeAppliesTo` (GraphicOverrideFillTypes): The fills the fill type override applies to. Left out: all fills.
- `fillForegroundPen` (integer): The pen index that replaces the foreground pen of fills.
- `fillForegroundPenAppliesTo` (GraphicOverrideFillTypes): The fills the foreground pen override applies to. Left out: all fills.
- `fillBackgroundPen` (integer): The pen index that replaces the background pen of fills. Use either this or fillBackgroundColor.
- `fillBackgroundColor` (ColorRGB): The color that replaces the background pen of fills. Use either this or fillBackgroundPen.
- `fillBackgroundPenAppliesTo` (GraphicOverrideFillTypes): The fills the background pen override applies to. Left out: all fills.
- `surface` (AttributeId): The surface that replaces the surface of elements. Use either this or surfaceColor.
- `surfaceColor` (ColorRGB): The color that replaces the surface of elements. Use either this or surface.
- `surfaceAppliesTo` (GraphicOverrideSurfaceTypes): The surfaces the surface override applies to. Left out: all surfaces.
- `showSkinSeparators` (boolean): Show the skin separator lines.
- `overridePenColorAndThickness` (boolean): Override the pen color and thickness.
- `hiddenContours` (GraphicOverrideSurfaceTypes): The contours to hide when overrideContours is true.
- `overrideContours` (boolean): Override the contour visibility.

### GraphicOverrideRule

object: A graphic override rule with its rule group, criterion and style.
- `graphicOverrideRuleId` (GraphicOverrideRuleId, required)
- `name` (string, required)
- `ruleGroupName` (string): The name of the rule group the rule belongs to.
- `criterionXML` (string, required): The criterion of the rule, in the XML format Archicad saves override rules in. Change its values and pass it to CreateGraphicOverrideRules or ModifyGraphicOverrideRules to make similar rules.
- `style` (GraphicOverrideStyle, required)

### GraphicOverrideRuleOrError

GraphicOverrideRule or ErrorItem: A graphic override rule or an error.

### AnalyticalModelVariation

object: The variation a Structural Analytical Model is generated for. Its fields depend on the Archicad version: amVariationGuid from Archicad 27, renovationFilterGuid and layerConnectionClassIds before.
- `amVariationGuid` (GuidId): The identifier of the analytical model variation. Archicad 27 and newer.
- `renovationFilterGuid` (GuidId): The identifier of the renovation filter of the variation. Archicad 25 and 26.
- `layerConnectionClassIds` (array of integer or object): The connection classes of the layers. Archicad 25: a list of integers. Archicad 26: one object per layer, with the layer's attribute index and its connection class.

### AnalyticalMemberType

string ("Unknown", "Beam", "Column", "Roof", "Slab", "Wall"): The analytical member type of an element.

### AnalyticalVisibilitySettings

object: The visibility settings of the Structural Analytical Model. Archicad 26 and newer.
- `visibilityMode` (string ("AnalyticalModelOnly", "AnalyticalModelWithinEntireModel")): Whether only the analytical model is shown or the analytical model within the entire model.
- `isAnalyticalModelVisible` (boolean)
- `areMembersTransparent` (boolean)
- `areSymbolsTransparent` (boolean)
- `areNodesVisible` (boolean)
- `areReleasesVisible` (boolean)
- `areCrossSectionsVisible` (boolean)
- `areCoordinationProfilesVisible` (boolean)
- `areLocalCoordSystemsVisible` (boolean)
- `loadVisibilityMode` (string ("FilterByActive", "HideAll", "ShowAll")): Which loads are shown: filtered by the active settings, none or all.

### AnalyticalLoadGroupType

string ("PermanentLoad", "VariableLoad", "AccidentalLoad", "SeismicLoad", "MovingLoad", "TensioningLoad", "FireLoad"): The type of a structural analysis load group.

### AnalyticalLoadGroupRelation

string ("ExclusiveRelation", "StandardRelation", "TogetherRelation"): How the load cases of a structural analysis load group are combined.

### AnalyticalLoadCaseActionType

string ("PermanentAction", "VariableAction", "AccidentalAction"): The action type of a structural analysis load case.

### AnalyticalLoadCaseLoadType

string ("SelfWeightLoad", "PrestressLoad", "DynamicLoad", "StaticLoad", "TemperatureLoad", "WindLoad", "SnowLoad", "MaintenanceLoad", "FireLoad", "MovingLoad", "SeismicLoad", "StandardLoad", ...): The load type of a structural analysis load case.

### AnalyticalLoadCaseDuration

string ("LongDuration", "MediumDuration", "ShortDuration", "InstantaneousDuration"): The duration of a structural analysis load case.

### AnalyticalLoadCombinationCategory

string ("ULS", "SLS", "ALS", "ANS", "NotDefined"): The category of a structural analysis load combination.

### AnalyticalLoadCombinationNationalStandard

string ("ENULSSTRGEOSetB", "ENULSSTRGEOSetC", "ENAccidental1", "ENAccidental2", "ENSeismic", "ENSLSCharacteristic", "ENSLSFrequent", "ENSLSQuasipermanent", "IBCLRFDultimate", "IBCASDultimate", "IBCASDserviceability", "IBCASDseismic", ...): The national standard of a structural analysis load combination.

### AnalyticalLoadCombinationType

string ("Envelope", "Linear", "Nonlinear"): The type of a structural analysis load combination. Archicad 27 and newer.

### AnalyticalLoadFactor

object: A load case of a structural analysis load combination with its factors.
- `loadCaseId` (GuidId, required): The identifier of the load case.
- `factor` (number): The factor of the load case. Left out when it is not set.
- `multiplier` (number, required): The multiplier of the load case.

### AnalyticalLoadGroup

object: A structural analysis load group.
- `loadGroupId` (GuidId, required)
- `name` (string, required)
- `groupType` (AnalyticalLoadGroupType)
- `relation` (AnalyticalLoadGroupRelation)
- `loadType` (string): The load type of the group as free text.

### AnalyticalLoadCase

object: A structural analysis load case.
- `loadCaseId` (GuidId, required)
- `name` (string, required)
- `description` (string)
- `actionType` (AnalyticalLoadCaseActionType)
- `loadGroupId` (GuidId, required): The identifier of the load group the load case belongs to.
- `loadType` (AnalyticalLoadCaseLoadType)
- `duration` (AnalyticalLoadCaseDuration): Left out when it is not set.

### AnalyticalLoadCombination

object: A structural analysis load combination.
- `loadCombinationId` (GuidId, required)
- `name` (string, required)
- `description` (string)
- `category` (AnalyticalLoadCombinationCategory)
- `nationalStandard` (AnalyticalLoadCombinationNationalStandard): Left out when it is not set.
- `type` (AnalyticalLoadCombinationType): Left out when it is not set. Archicad 27 and newer.
- `loadFactors` (array of AnalyticalLoadFactor, required): The load cases of the combination with their factors.

### AnalyticalNode

object: A node of the Structural Analytical Model.
- `nodeId` (integer, required): The identifier of the node.
- `coord` (Coordinate3D, required)

### AnalyticalCurve

object: A curve of the Structural Analytical Model.
- `type` (string ("Line", "Arc", "Spline", "Bezier", "Ellipse")): The type of the curve. Bezier exists from Archicad 26.
- `begNode` (AnalyticalNode, required)
- `endNode` (AnalyticalNode, required)
- `midCoords` (array of Coordinate3D, required): The points between the start and the end of the curve.

### AnalyticalCrossSection

object: The cross section of a curve member. The profile image of Archicad 26 and newer is not returned.
- `crossSectionType` (string ("Rectangle", "Circle", "Attribute", "Custom"))
- `width` (number)
- `height` (number)
- `veneerThickness` (number)
- `profileAttrIndex` (integer): The attribute index of the profile.
- `materialAttrIndices` (array of integer): The attribute indices of the materials of the cross section.
- `profileParameters` (array of object): The parameters of the profile.
  - `parameterId` (GuidId, required)
  - `value` (number, required)
- `alignment` (string ("TopLeft", "Top", "TopRight", "Left", "Center", "Right", "BottomLeft", "Bottom", "BottomRight", "None")): The alignment of the cross section. Archicad 26 and newer.

### AnalyticalCurveMember

object: A curve member (beam, column) of the Structural Analytical Model.
- `analyticalMemberType` (AnalyticalMemberType)
- `elemGuid` (GuidId)
- `crossSection` (AnalyticalCrossSection)
- `curve` (AnalyticalCurve)
- `internalNodes` (array of AnalyticalNode)
- `rotationAngle` (number)
- `ey` (number)
- `eyVector` (Coordinate3D)
- `ez` (number)
- `ezVector` (Coordinate3D)
- `layerAttrIndex` (integer): The attribute index of the layer.
- `FEMType` (string ("Standard", "AxialForceOnly", "CompressionOnly", "TensionOnly"))
- `varyingSegmentList` (array of object): The segments of a member with varying cross section. Archicad 26 and newer.
  - `begProfile` (AnalyticalCrossSection, required)
  - `endProfile` (AnalyticalCrossSection): Only for a tapered segment.
  - `span` (number, required)

### AnalyticalSurfaceMember

object: A surface member (wall, slab, roof) or a segment of one of the Structural Analytical Model.
- `analyticalMemberType` (AnalyticalMemberType)
- `elemGuid` (GuidId)
- `surface` (object)
  - `surfaceType` (string ("Plane", "Cylinder"))
  - `planeSurface` (object)
  - `cylinderSurface` (object)
- `contour` (array of AnalyticalCurve): The curves of the outer contour.
- `holeContours` (array of object): The contours of the holes.
  - `contour` (array of AnalyticalCurve, required)
- `internalNodes` (array of AnalyticalNode)
- `thickness` (number)
- `lcsXVector` (Coordinate3D): The X axis of the local coordinate system. Archicad 26 and newer.
- `ez` (number)
- `ezVector` (Coordinate3D)
- `materialAttrIndex` (integer): The attribute index of the material.
- `layerAttrIndex` (integer): The attribute index of the layer.
- `FEMType` (string ("Plate", "Wall", "Shell"))
- `groupId` (GuidId)

### AnalyticalMemberConnections

array of GuidId: The identifiers of the connections of the analytical member.

### AnalyticalInternalMemberPartId

object: Identifies a part of an analytical member by its contour, edge or vertex and edge fragment.
- `contourIdx` (integer)
- `edgeOrVertexIdx` (integer)
- `edgeFragmentIndex` (integer)

### AnalyticalExportMappingTable

object
- `items` (array of object, required)
  - `partId` (AnalyticalInternalMemberPartId, required)
  - `elemPartIds` (array of object, required)

### AnalyticalExportIdMapping

object: Maps the edges and vertices of a surface member to the parts of the exported members. Archicad 26 and newer.
- `edges` (AnalyticalExportMappingTable, required)
- `vertices` (AnalyticalExportMappingTable, required)

### AnalyticalMemberPartRef

object: A reference to a part (vertex, edge or surface) of an analytical member. partId, customVertexData and ratioEdgeData are zero when left out.
- `elemGuid` (GuidId, required): The element of the analytical member.
- `partRefType` (string ("BegVertex", "EndVertex", "CustomVertex", "Edge", "RatioEdge", "Surface", "CustomSurface", "CustomEdge"), required)
- `partId` (AnalyticalInternalMemberPartId)
- `customVertexData` (object): The point of a CustomVertex.
  - `customVertexCoord` (Coordinate3D)
- `ratioEdgeData` (object): The part of the edge of a RatioEdge.
  - `ratioStart` (number)
  - `ratioEnd` (number)

### AnalyticalRigidityType

string ("Free", "Rigid", "Custom", "RigidCompressionOnly", "RigidTensionOnly", "CustomCompressionOnly", "CustomTensionOnly"): The rigidity of a degree of freedom of a release.

### AnalyticalRelease

object: The release of an analytical member.
- `guid` (GuidId, required): The identifier of the release.
- `releaseDescriptions` (array of object, required): The releases of the member parts. Each needs all six rigidities; a stiffness left out is 0.
  - `ux` (AnalyticalRigidityType, required)
  - `stiffnessX` (number)
  - `uy` (AnalyticalRigidityType, required)
  - `stiffnessY` (number)
  - `uz` (AnalyticalRigidityType, required)
  - `stiffnessZ` (number)
  - `fix` (AnalyticalRigidityType, required)
  - `stiffnessFix` (number)
  - `fiy` (AnalyticalRigidityType, required)
  - `stiffnessFiy` (number)
  - `fiz` (AnalyticalRigidityType, required)
  - `stiffnessFiz` (number)
  - `amPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)

### AnalyticalCoordinateSystem

object: A local coordinate system, given by its X and Y axes.
- `xVector` (Coordinate3D, required)
- `yVector` (Coordinate3D, required)

### AnalyticalCoordSysDirection

string ("Global", "Local"): Whether the values are in the global or in the local coordinate system.

### AnalyticalSupport

object: An analytical support: its settings and the member part it supports. Every rigidity type is required; a value left out is 0.
- `supportSettings` (object, required)
  - `supportType` (string ("SimplePoint", "SingleLine", "Surface"), required)
  - `supportValues` (object, required): The rigidity and the value of the three translations and the three rotations.
  - `coordinateSystem` (AnalyticalCoordSysDirection, required)
- `supportedMemberPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)

### AnalyticalSupportGeometry

object: The geometry of an analytical support in a Structural Analytical Model.
- `coordinates` (array of Coordinate3D, required)
- `translationStiffnessVector` (Coordinate3D, required)
- `rotationStiffnessVector` (Coordinate3D, required)

### AnalyticalLink

object: An analytical link: its settings and the member parts it connects. The rigid and the spring settings are both required, whichever type the link has. Every rigidity type is required; a value left out is 0 and a resistance left out is false.
- `linkSettings` (object, required)
  - `geometry` (string ("Link1D", "Link2D"), required)
  - `type` (string ("Rigid", "Spring"), required)
  - `rigidSettings` (object, required)
  - `springSettings` (object, required)
- `startElementPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)
- `endElementPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)

### AnalyticalLinkGeometry

object: The geometry of an analytical link in a Structural Analytical Model.
- `coordinates` (array of Coordinate3D, required)
- `translationStiffnessVector` (Coordinate3D, required)
- `rotationStiffnessVector` (Coordinate3D, required)
- `curves` (array of AnalyticalCurve, required)

### AnalyticalLoadForceType

string ("Force", "Moment"): Whether the load is a force or a moment.

### AnalyticalPointLoad

object: An analytical point load: its settings and the member part it loads.
- `loadSettings` (object, required)
  - `loadCaseId` (GuidId, required): The load case the load belongs to.
  - `loadForceType` (AnalyticalLoadForceType, required)
  - `coordinateSystemType` (AnalyticalCoordSysDirection, required)
  - `xValue` (number, required)
  - `yValue` (number, required)
  - `zValue` (number, required)
- `loadedMemberPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)

### AnalyticalEdgeLoad

object: An analytical edge load: its settings and the member part it loads.
- `loadSettings` (object, required)
  - `loadCaseId` (GuidId, required): The load case the load belongs to.
  - `loadForceType` (AnalyticalLoadForceType, required)
  - `loadDistributionType` (string ("Uniform", "Trapezoid"), required): Whether the load is the same along the edge or changes from the start value to the end value.
  - `coordinateSystemType` (AnalyticalCoordSysDirection, required)
  - `startValue` (Coordinate3D, required)
  - `endValue` (Coordinate3D, required)
- `loadedMemberPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)

### AnalyticalSurfaceLoad

object: An analytical surface load: its settings and the member part it loads.
- `loadSettings` (object, required)
  - `loadCaseId` (GuidId, required): The load case the load belongs to.
  - `coordinateSystemType` (AnalyticalCoordSysDirection, required)
  - `xValue` (number, required)
  - `yValue` (number, required)
  - `zValue` (number, required)
- `loadedMemberPartRef` (AnalyticalMemberPartRef, required)

### AnalyticalEdgeLoadCustomData

object: The curve of an analytical edge load. CreateAnalyticalLoads needs at least one curve.
- `curve` (array of AnalyticalCurve, required)

### AnalyticalSurfaceLoadCustomData

object: The contour of an analytical surface load. CreateAnalyticalLoads needs at least one curve.
- `contour` (array of AnalyticalCurve, required)
